data.title: Visions of the Unwritten - Act II: Echoes of the Fall

objective1.description: Consult the Oracle regarding the Morrell Station assassination
objective1.dial: Morpheus sought the truth in the shadows of the code. Go to where the flies gathered, in Morrell Station.

objective2.description: Activate Seraphic Vision to perceive temporal residue
objective2.dial: Shift your sight to the golden spectrum. Look past the green rain to where the code calcified.

objective3.description: Trace the Assassin's viral code footprint in Morrell Station
objective3.dial: Residual flies buzzing... Death was programmed here before the trigger was ever pulled.

objective4.dial: The contract is perpetual. Morpheus was only the beginning.

objective5.description: Report the viral residue back to the Oracle
objective5.dial: The Assassin was not an isolated operative. He was hired with code from outside the system.
